question: which schools got less than half the applications we expected from them, matching names loosely (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)

CURRENT QUESTION:
which schools got less than half the applications we expected from them, matching names loosely (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH matched_schools AS (
  SELECT
    lo."School Name" AS school_name,
    la."School" AS application_school,
    jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(lo."School Name")), lower(trim(la."School"))) AS similarity
  FROM "lpf_outreach" lo
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_applications" la ON TRUE
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lo."School Name" ORDER BY similarity DESC) = 1
),

expected_vs_actual AS (
  SELECT
    ms.school_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(lo."Applications Expected"), 0) AS expected_applications,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.application_school IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_applications
  FROM matched_schools ms
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_outreach" lo ON ms.school_name = lo."School Name"
  GROUP BY ms.school_name
)

SELECT
  school_name,
  expected_applications,
  actual_applications,
  (actual_applications * 100.0 / NULLIF(expected_applications, 0)) AS percentage_of_expected
FROM expected_vs_actual
WHERE actual_applications < (expected_applications / 2)
ORDER BY percentage_of_expected;
```
